description: Source code for the EngineSnifferPanel class, which manages the UI components and logic for engine signal visualization and chart display in a Java Swing application.

classes.name: EngineSnifferPanel
classes.description: Main class managing the engine signal visualization panel, including UI components, chart display, and interaction logic.

classes.name: ImageOrderComparator
classes.description: Comparator for ordering image names, prioritizing certain prefixes for display order.

methods.name: setPaused
methods.description: Sets the paused state and updates the pause button label.

methods.name: displayChart
methods.description: Parses and displays engine chart data, updating images and UI accordingly.

methods.name: createSecondaryImage
methods.description: Creates and inserts a new UpDownImage for a given signal name if it doesn't already exist.

methods.name: getInsertIndex
methods.description: Determines the insertion index for a new image based on sorted order.

methods.name: saveImage
methods.description: Saves the current panel view as an image file with a filename based on RPM and MAF sensor values.

methods.name: createImage
methods.description: Creates an UpDownImage with color coding based on the signal name prefix.

methods.name: reloadFile
methods.description: Reloads the chart from the repository and resets the scroll control.

methods.name: getTabSelectedListener
methods.description: Returns an ActionListener that focuses the command input when the tab is selected.
